name: biteducation
description: Três sites interativos para ver o computador por dentro: redes, sistemas operacionais e arquitetura.

scripts.build: vite build && tsx scripts/prerender.ts && tsx scripts/build-sw.ts && tsx scripts/check-dist.ts
scripts.check: biome check . && tsc --noEmit && tsx scripts/check-imports.ts && tsx scripts/check-content.ts && vitest run
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run build:review && playwright test && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
